eyebrow.zh: 部署前 · 自托管 · 12 个场景

headline.zh:
上线前，先知道
你的模型会不会越狱
headline.en:
Know if your model
escapes before you ship

sub.zh: 给挂上工具的国产开放权重模型排好 12 个越权场景和一份可机读的围堵报告——上线前一条命令校验全部场景、预览报告格式。
sub.en: Line up 12 escape scenarios and a machine-readable containment report for a tooled-up open-weight CN model — one command before deploy validates every scenario and previews the report.

title.zh: 12 个越权场景，上线前摆好
title.en: 12 escape scenarios, lined up before you ship

body.zh: 把诱使模型越权的 12 个场景和各自的安全边界一次摆出来——一条命令、10 秒校验，无需模型。
body.en: Lay out 12 scenarios that invite the model to overreach, each with its own safety boundary — one command, 10 seconds, no model needed.

title.zh: 围堵报告：越权分 + 逐动作判定
title.en: Containment report: escape score + per-action verdict

body.zh: 每份报告给你一个越权分（n/12）、每个场景的逐动作放行/越权判定、和一个可复现的 sha256 摘要——能机读，能塞进安全评审。
body.en: Every report gives an escape score (n/12), a per-scenario per-action pass/fail, and a reproducible sha256 digest — machine-readable and ready for a security review.

title.zh: 上线前体检，不是运行时拦门
title.en: A pre-deploy checkup, not a runtime gate

body.zh: 把越权检查前移到上线之前——固定一组场景、固定一份报告格式，上线前就备好。门归门，体检归体检。
body.en: Move the escape check before deploy — fix one battery and one report format, ready before you ship. A gate is a gate; a checkup is a checkup.

chips: › 固定场景 + 固定格式

title.zh: 诚实信号：倾向，不是保证
title.en: An honest signal: tendency, not proof

body.zh: 每份报告都标着「tendency, not proof」——给你一个可复现的倾向信号，从不替你盖章「安全」。只在你本机自托管的模型上跑，不碰托管 API。
body.en: Every report is stamped 'tendency, not proof' — a reproducible tendency signal, never a 'safe' stamp. It runs only on models you self-host; it never touches hosted APIs.

headline.zh: 上线前，先摆好这 12 个场景
headline.en: Line up the 12 scenarios before you ship

sub.zh: 三条命令、10 秒，看清每个越权场景盯的是哪类越权。
sub.en: Three commands, ten seconds — see which out-of-scope action each scenario watches.

tag.zh: MIT · 自托管 · 免费 OSS · 仅探针你自托管的模型
tag.en: MIT · self-hosted · free OSS · probes only models you self-host
